description: This file defines the TalkModeManager class, which manages voice interaction modes in an Android application. It handles speech recognition, text-to-speech playback, chat session subscription, and the coordination of voice commands, including starting/stopping recognition, handling recognition results, executing chat requests, and producing TTS outputs.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Manages voice interaction, speech recognition, and TTS in an Android app, coordinating chat sessions and user commands.

methods.name: ensureChatSubscribed
methods.description: Ensures chat subscription is active by reloading config and subscribing if needed.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key for chat interactions.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice mode, initiating start or stop procedures accordingly.

methods.name: speakWakeCommand
methods.description: Handles the process of sending a wake command, waiting for a reply, and playing assistant response.

methods.name: playTtsForText
methods.description: Plays TTS for the provided text.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from the gateway, including chat updates and responses.

methods.name: setPlaybackEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice playback.

methods.name: refreshConfig
methods.description: Reloads configuration settings.

methods.name: speakAssistantReply
methods.description: Speaks an assistant's reply text via TTS.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins voice recognition, setting up SpeechRecognizer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops voice recognition and related processes, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: startListeningInternal
methods.description: Internal method to start speech recognition with intent configuration.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules recognition restart after an error or end of speech.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Handles recognition results, managing partial and final transcripts.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring speech silence to finalize recognition.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence duration exceeds threshold to finalize transcript.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Finalizes recognition, sends chat request, and manages TTS playback.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat session updates if supported and needed.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt string for chat requests, including context and transcript.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends chat message request, returns run ID.

methods.name: waitForChatFinal
methods.description: Waits for chat final response using a deferred promise.

methods.name: cacheRunCompletion
methods.description: Caches completion state of a run ID.

methods.name: consumeRunCompletion
methods.description: Retrieves and removes run completion state.

methods.name: consumeRunText
methods.description: Retrieves and removes text from a completed run.

methods.name: extractTextFromChatEventMessage
methods.description: Extracts message text content from chat event JSON.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for latest assistant message since a timestamp.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches recent assistant text messages from chat history.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Handles TTS playback of assistant's response, parsing talk directives.

methods.name: runPlaybackSession
methods.description: Runs a playback session, managing TTS and state.

methods.name: cancelActivePlayback
methods.description: Cancels any active TTS playback.

methods.name: speakWithSystemTts
methods.description: Uses Android TextToSpeech engine to produce speech with directives for language and speed.

methods.name: stopTts
methods.description: Stops ongoing TTS speech and resets state.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops TTS playback and resets related states.

methods.name: shouldAllowSpeechInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if speech can be interrupted controlling TTS state.

methods.name: clearListenWatchdog
methods.description: Clears the listening watchdog timer.

methods.name: requestAudioFocusForTts
methods.description: Requests audio focus for TTS playback.

methods.name: abandonAudioFocus
methods.description: Releases audio focus when TTS stops.

methods.name: ensureTextToSpeech
methods.description: Initializes and returns TextToSpeech engine, ensuring singleton.

methods.name: stopTextToSpeechPlayback
methods.description: Stops current TTS playback.

methods.name: shutdownTextToSpeech
methods.description: Shutdown and releases TextToSpeech engine resources.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines if recognition should be interrupted based on transcript.

methods.name: ensurePlaybackActive
methods.description: Checks if current playback token is valid for ongoing audio.

methods.name: isPlaybackCancelled
methods.description: Checks if playback should be canceled based on errors or state.

methods.name: ensureConfigLoaded
methods.description: Ensures configuration is loaded, reloads if necessary.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Loads config related to silence timeout and speech recognition parameters.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Parses run ID from JSON string.

methods.name: resolveSpeed
methods.description: Resolves speech rate and speed settings into a ratio.

methods.name: validatedLanguage
methods.description: Validates the language code for TTS.

methods.name: isMessageTimestampAfter
methods.description: Checks if a message timestamp is after a given threshold.
